g.text: MESSAGES Messages to send (prefix files with @)
--smol=<value> Smol/fast model for lightweight tasks (or PI_SMOL_MODEL env)
--slow=<value> Slow/reasoning model for thorough analysis (or PI_SLOW_MODEL
--plan=<value> Plan model for architectural planning (or PI_PLAN_MODEL env)
--prewalk Switch from the active model to a fast/cheap model at the fi
rst edit/write after the plan's todo list exists (default off; see prewalk.enabled)
--no-prewalk Disable prewalk even if prewalk.enabled is set
--prewalk-into=<value> Target model for prewalk (default the "smol" role)
--plan-yolo Force read-only plan mode at start, auto-approve the plan on
the model's first resolve call, then switch to --plan-yolo-into to implement it
--plan-yolo-into=<value> Target model for plan-yolo execution (default the "smol" rol
